acl.adminOnly: Only Workspace administrators can manage access control
acl.hint: Grant View / Edit / Manage to subjects (platform users, Agents, Squads, roles). Adding or removing grants is an administrator action.
acl.empty: No additional grants. Workspace administrators can still manage memory, and Agents can maintain their own personal memory.
acl.subjectHelp: Enter a user, Agent or Squad ID, such as Agent 40013. For role grants, enter the role name.
acl.permissionHelp: View: read content. Edit: create, update and delete. Manage: includes edit permissions. Agents can still write only to their own personal memory.

import.retireConfirm: Stopping ends further imports from this source. Continue?
import.adminOnly: Only Workspace administrators can manage local memory sources
import.notice: Local sources are legacy Qoder/QoderCN memory files, separate from platform legacy memory migration. Recuration rebuilds the index without rewriting the original text, and a missing local file does not mean platform memory was lost: it may not exist yet, may have moved, or may not be a readable regular file. Imported platform memory is retained when the local file disappears.
import.empty: No local files available to import
